'''Shellaster''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Major/Legends|major]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] serving on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. At one point during his career, he was stationed outside [[Kaas City]] where he was tasked to dealing with an invasion of off-world troops under the command of the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tytonus]], an ally of [[Grathan|Lord Grathan]].
